headline: 4 arrested as Radda health centre demolished in Mirpur overnight
summary: A 50-year-old healthcare center for mothers and children was razed by an excavator overnight; DMP commissioner orders probe into police negligence.
details: A 50-year-old healthcare center, the Radda MCH-FP Center in Mirpur, was demolished overnight using heavy excavators. The facility, which primarily served underprivileged mothers and children, saw its medical equipment and vaccines looted during the attack.
caption:
A 50-year-old health center for mothers and children was razed to the ground overnight in Mirpur. Now, the DMP commissioner is probing why police failed to stop it.

A 50-year-old healthcare center, the Radda MCH-FP Center in Mirpur, was demolished overnight using heavy excavators. The facility, which primarily served underprivileged mothers and children, saw its medical equipment and vaccines looted during the attack.

#Bangladesh #Mirpur #Healthcare #Justice #DhakaNews

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline: Mother and 10-month-old baby killed in Manikganj road crash
summary: A mother and her infant daughter died after a speeding bus traveling the wrong way hit their motorcycle on the Dhaka-Aricha highway.
details: A mother and her 10-month-old daughter were killed on Saturday afternoon in the Tepra bus stand area of the Dhaka-Aricha highway in Shibalay, Manikganj.
caption:
A mother and her 10-month-old baby were killed after a speeding bus traveling the wrong way hit their motorcycle in Manikganj.

A mother and her 10-month-old daughter were killed on Saturday afternoon in the Tepra bus stand area of the Dhaka-Aricha highway in Shibalay, Manikganj.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV
